t: Mapei Mapesil AC 132 is a premium solvent-free silicone sealant designed for reliable sealing applications in both interior and exterior environments. This waterproof and mould-resistant sealant offers excellent performance for sanitary installations, such as around wash basins, bath tubs, and shower trays in commercial and domestic settings. It withstands temperatures up to 180°C and provides robust chemical resistance, ensuring durability. The beige colour coordinates seamlessly with the Mapei Ultracolour Plus Grout range, providing a professional finish for renovation or new build projects.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
